metadata.overview: Provides orchestration capabilities to control and read data from MicroBT Whatsminer Bitcoin miners. Operations here effect physical hardware. Always prioritize thermal safety and verify telemetry changes after issuing commands.

telemetry.name: hashrate_rt
telemetry.description: Real-time hashrate. A value of 0 implies the miner is offline, booting, or experiencing a catastrophic failure.

telemetry.name: power_draw
telemetry.description: Current power draw. If dramatically lower than the current limit_watts, a hashboard might be dead.

telemetry.name: temperature_in
telemetry.description: Ambient air temperature entering the miner.

telemetry.name: temperature_out
telemetry.description: Outlet temperature. Critical metric. If this exceeds 85C reliably, intervention is required.

telemetry.name: fan_speed_in
telemetry.description: Inlet fan speed. Below 2000 RPM usually indicates a broken fan.

telemetry.name: fan_speed_out
telemetry.description: Outlet fan speed. Below 2000 RPM usually indicates a broken fan.

commands.name: reboot
commands.description: Safely restarts the controller. Takes approx 2-3 minutes for the dashboard to respond again.
commands.constraints: Do not call sequentially within 5 minutes. Never issue this command more than once in a 15-minute window. Allow time for the boot telemetry to settle.

commands.name: setPowerLimit
commands.constraints: Never set below 2000W or hashboards may fail to initialize. Max is usually model-dependent (up to 3500W-4000W).

examples.intent: Optimize for low power or thermal limiting during a hot day

commands.name: setPools
commands.description: Updates the primary mining pool configuration.

troubleshooting: If alert.overheat or E_TEMP_HIGH is reported, verify fan_speed_in and fan_speed_out. A fan speed of 0 is a mechanical failure.
If alert.hashrate_low triggers, the miner might be tuning its boards (expected after an environment or power change, wait ~15 minutes).
If status is OFFLINE, do not attempt to run 'reboot' as the telemetry layer cannot reach the device. Escalate to human operator.

errors.E_PSU_ERR: Power supply unit report error or unstable output
